description.value: Benanna Bakery is a quaint, artisanal European-inspired bakery in Chilliwack that has been baking from scratch since 2012. They are known for sourdoughs made with 16+ hour fermentation, traditional European pastries and cakes, and custom celebration cakes using locally sourced ingredients. A touring cyclist stopping here would find freshly baked breads and pastries made daily in-shop — a solid resupply for energy on the road.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully accessible and confirms the business is open and active, corroborating all OSM contact fields (address, phone, website). The site describes a well-established artisanal bakery selling sourdough, pastries, and cakes with online ordering and a loyalty program — no cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags, so those fields remain null. The OSM shop=bakery tag mapped to 'Groceries' is a loose fit but acceptable for a directory where cyclists may want a food stop.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible artisanal bakery with active website and confirmed contact details — a useful food stop for touring cyclists passing through Chilliwack.
enrichment_extras.notes: Email address orders@benannabakery.com found on website but not present in OSM tags.

provenance.category_correction_reason: OSM shop=bakery is mapped to Groceries; the business is a specialty artisanal bakery rather than a general grocery, but it is a legitimate food stop for touring cyclists and the category mapping is acceptable.
